fingerprint.structure: 8 slides: hook ('RANKING GYM SPLITS' + mascot with 4 calendar cards) → 7 ranked items counting down #7 to #1, each with a score badge (1/10 to 11/10), a one-line verdict and a weekly split strip of mascots with the trained muscles in red. No CTA
fingerprint.hook: Ranking promise 'RANKING GYM SPLITS' (italic condensed) over the mascot surrounded by calendar cards labelled BRO SPLIT, PUSH PULL LEGS, UPPER/LOWER, FBEOD
fingerprint.camera_motion: 2d-characters (mascot) inside designed cards; diagrams built from repeated mascots; 4:5 slides
fingerprint.pacing: 8 slides, 12 to 25 words of body text per item
fingerprint.text_overlay: Headings: Anton-like condensed heavy grotesque, Title Case (ALL CAPS on covers), navy #041732 with accent blue; '#N' numerals in blue, slightly italic; short blue underline (about 12.6% wide) under each heading; body: Didact Gothic-like light sans, gray #4b4945, about 2.7% of frame height, left-aligned at x=10%, 2 to 4 short lines; BLUE BRO logo top-left on every slide; ranking slides use a humanist bold sans for the item title and a colored score badge
fingerprint.audio: third-party sound (library-style title and author), not original, no voiceover; slideshow so the sound is only background
fingerprint.arc: Countdown from worst to best → the best gets 11/10 (a joke score)
